🎥🎬: Vacation (2015)

Rusty Griswold wants to reconnect with his wife, Debbie, and their two sons, so he decides to recreate the family road trip he enjoyed as a child. Hoping to give his family an unforgettable experience, he plans a cross-country journey to the legendary Walley World theme park.

Unfortunately, the trip quickly turns into a disaster. From bizarre roadside encounters and embarrassing family moments to dangerous detours and unexpected mishaps, almost everything that can go wrong does. Rusty’s attempts to keep everyone happy only make the situation more chaotic.

As the Griswolds travel across the country, they discover that their family vacation is becoming one ridiculous adventure after another. Between sibling rivalry, marital tension and outrageous situations, the family learns that sometimes the worst trips create the funniest memories.

source_details.title: Vacation
source_details.synopsis: Vacation is a 2015 American comedy road movie, written and directed by John Francis Daley and Jonathan Goldstein. It stars Ed Helms, Christina Applegate, Leslie Mann, Beverly D'Angelo, Chris Hemsworth, and Chevy Chase. It is a sequel to Vegas Vacation (1997) and the sixth installment of the National Lampoon's Vacation film series. Vacation was released on July 29, 2015, by Warner Bros. Pictures. The film received generally negative reviews from critics but was a box office success grossing $107.2 million on a $31 million budget.
